propositions: The pagination structural guard scans only transport.py but commit 465d moved all search_issues calls out of transport.py into _base.py and _issues.py, leaving the guard vacuous with zero offenders to detect
The guard's predicate _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() returns an empty list on the current codebase because its hardcoded single-file AST scan population is now empty

The guard's docstring and design intent requires it to enforce that all pagination calls take an explicit cap, but it cannot fail and thus cannot prevent future unpaginated calls added to other modules in the adapter
The fix must widen the scan from a single transport.py file to every *.py in adapters/jira_datacenter/ and add a non-vacuity assertion that the scan observes actual call sites
A teeth test must prove the widened predicate can detect uncapped search_issues calls in non-transport modules, confirming the directory-wide scan is exercised
An audit of other single-file AST guards in the test suite must identify whether the same module-split rot affected other guards
